jobs.title: Head of Finance / FP&A (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du machst unser Wachstum steuerbar.

TEILE  entwickelt und produziert High-End-Lautsprecher, DJ- und Audio-Equipment sowie Merch – Design-Objekte mit kompromisslosem Klang. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Systeme spielen in Clubs, auf Festivals, in Bars, Hotels und Restaurants.  Hinter  TEILE  steht eine weltweite Community mit sehr hoher Reichweite. Gerade bauen wir neue Vertriebskanäle auf: eigener Onlineshop, Social Commerce, Handels- und Objektpartner sowie Kooperationen mit großen Marken. Wir wachsen schnell – und bisher ohne Finanzfunktion. Es gibt kein Controlling, keine strukturierte Datenbasis, keine Systeme, die miteinander sprechen. Genau das baust du auf.  Deine Rolle  Du wirst die Person, die  TEILE  steuerbar macht. Du bringst den Blick eines CFO mit und baust trotzdem gern selbst – vom ersten Forecast bis zur Datenpipeline.  Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CEO und dem Gründerteam zusammen und machst KI von Anfang an zum Kern unserer Steuerung: automatisierte Reportings, datenbasierte Entscheidungen und smarte Prozesse statt manueller Routinen.  Deine Aufgaben

Finance & FP&A aufbauen: Planung, Forecast, Liquidität und Reporting – mit einer Steuerungslogik, die mit uns skaliert.

Profitabilität sichtbar machen: Deckungsbeiträge pro Produkt, Kanal und Projekt – von der Werkstatt bis zum Webshop.

Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen.

Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos.

AI-First denken: Abläufe in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service automatisieren

Tech-Landschaft verantworten: Tools auswählen, Systeme verbinden, externe Dienstleister steuern.

Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling oder FP&A – idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen mit physischen Produkten

Du hast Planung, Controlling und Reporting schon einmal selbst aufgebaut – nicht nur übernommen

Ein Plus: Hintergrund bei einer Big-4-Gesellschaft (PwC, KPMG, EY, Deloitte)

Datenaffinität: BI-Tools, Data-Warehouse-Logik, gern SQL – du baust selbst mit

Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung

Strategisch denkend, hands-on, pragmatisch – du brauchst kein großes Team, um zu liefern

Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Ebenfalls ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Shopify und D2C

Das erwartet dich

Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum – du baust deinen Bereich von null auf

Direkter Draht zu CEO und Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege

Ein Produkt, das man hört: High-End-Sound zwischen Club, Festival und Wohnzimmer

Starkes Wachstum, neue Kanäle, internationale Projekte – und die Perspektive, ein eigenes Team aufzubauen

Homeoffice nach Absprache

Arbeitsmodell

Standort Berlin

Vollzeit

Regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort an beiden Standorten

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweck

jobs.title: Community Manager Schulen
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle  Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Schulen teech kennenlernen und bestehende Schulen sich bei uns gut aufgehoben fühlen. Dafür entwickelst du unser Schulnetzwerk eigenverantwortlich weiter, baust verlässliche Beziehungen zu Lehrkräften und Ansprechpartnern auf und begleitest Schulen bei der Nutzung unserer Bildungsformate.  Du behältst den gesamten Weg im Blick: vom ersten Kontakt über die erste Teilnahme bis zur regelmäßigen Nutzung im Unterricht. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung vereinbarst du konkrete Ziele und KPIs, steuerst deine Aktivitäten danach und berichtest regelmäßig über Fortschritte, Ergebnisse und Handlungsbedarf. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem gesamten teech-Team zusammen.  Deine Aufgaben  Neue Schulen identifizieren und gewinnen

Du recherchierst relevante Schulen und passende Ansprechpartner, priorisierst Potenziale und entwickelst unser Schulnetzwerk systematisch weiter.  Du stellst aktiv den Erstkontakt her - telefonisch, per E-Mail und über passende weitere Kontaktwege.  Du vermittelst den Nutzen unserer Angebote für Schule und Unterricht, fasst konsequent nach und gewinnst Schulen für die Teilnahme an unseren Formaten.

Schulen betreuen und Beziehungen ausbauen

Du bist ein verlässlicher Ansprechpartner für unsere Schulen und pflegst den regelmäßigen Austausch.  Du begleitest neue Schulen beim Einstieg, beantwortest Fragen und unterstützt sie dabei, passende Angebote für ihren Unterricht zu finden.  Du informierst gezielt über neue Formate, Veranstaltungen und Teilnahmemöglichkeiten.  Du erkennst, wenn Schulen Unterstützung brauchen oder länger nicht aktiv waren, und gehst auf sie zu.  Du holst Feedback ein und bringst die Bedürfnisse der Schulen strukturiert ins Team ein.

Eigenverantwortlich steuern und Ergebnisse sichtbar machen

Du organisierst deinen Bereich selbstständig und dokumentierst Kontakte, Aktivitäten und nächste Schritte nachvollziehbar.  Du arbeitest mit vereinbarten KPIs, beispielsweise zu neu gewonnenen Schulen, aktiven Schulen, Teilnahmen und wiederkehrender Nutzung.  Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings für die Geschäftsführung, ordnest Ergebnisse ein und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab.  Du entwickelst Abläufe für Ansprache und Betreuung weiter und nutzt digitale Werkzeuge, um wiederkehrende Aufgaben effizienter zu gestalten.

Im gesamten Team zusammenarbeiten

Du stimmst dich eng mit Projektmanagement, Sales, Marketing und Produktverantwortlichen ab.  Du verbindest die Bedürfnisse der Schulen mit unseren Angeboten und laufenden Projekten.  Ergänzend erstellst du zielgruppengerechte Einladungen, E-Mails und Newsletter und unterstützt bei Inhalten für Website, Plattform und Social Media. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Rolle bleibt die Gewinnung und Betreuung der Schulen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast Freude daran, Menschen anzusprechen, Beziehungen aufzubauen und diese langfristig zu pflegen.  Du kommunizierst klar, freundlich und verbindlich - auch am Telefon.  Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, setzt Priorit

jobs.title: Forschungsprojektleiter:in Energiedaten & Gebäudetechnik (d/w/m)
jobs.description:
termios macht Heizen in Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien smarter und klimafreundlicher. Unser Thermostat spart spürbar Energie und hilft Asset Managern, Wohnungsunternehmen und Eigentümern, ihre ESG- und Net-Zero-Ziele zu erreichen.  termios ist ein 2023 gegründetes Joint-Venture von mantro als Company Builder, dem sauerländischen Familienunternehmen Oventrop und der Düsseldorfer LEG Immobilien SE. Als Technologieunternehmen entwickeln wir grüne Lösungen rund um Heizen, Nachhaltigkeit und ESG für Wohnimmobilien.

Warum wir diese Stelle besetzen

Unser Thermostat termios Pro übernimmt den hydraulischen Abgleich automatisch, für jeden einzelnen Heizkörper, und ist in tausenden Wohnungen verbaut. Daraus entsteht ein Messdatenbestand zum realen Heizbetrieb im Gebäudebestand, wie ihn kaum ein einzelnes Forschungsprojekt aufbauen kann.  Wie viel Energie spart der automatische Abgleich wirklich, unter welchen Bedingungen, und wie weist man das sauber nach? Diese und ähnliche Fragestellungen wollen wir gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungsinstituten, Wohnungsunternehmen und Fördergebern beantworten.  Du startest dabei nicht bei null: Wir haben bereits zwei vom BMWE geförderte Forschungsprojekte und sind in weiteren Forschungsfeldern aktiv. Für dieses wachsende Portfolio suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt jemanden, der Forschung nicht nur organisiert, sondern selbst betreibt.  Deine Aufgaben

Studiendesign und Feldversuche:  Du übersetzt offene Fragen in prüfbare Hypothesen und ein belastbares Studiendesign mit Vergleichsgruppen, Baseline, Witterungsbereinigung und Messkonzept. Messkampagnen in realen Liegenschaften setzt du gemeinsam mit Field Service und Anlagentechnik um.

Datenanalyse:  Du wertest Zeitreihen aus dem Gerätebestand und aus Messkampagnen selbst aus, quantifizierst Effekte und Unsicherheiten und trennst sauber zwischen Korrelation und Wirkung.

Ergebnisse:  Du bereitest Erkenntnisse für Abschlussberichte, Fachpublikationen, Konferenzen und Kunden auf und sorgst dafür, dass sie in unsere Algorithmen und Produktentwicklung zurückfließen.

Projektleitung:  Du steuerst mehrere parallel laufende Forschungs- und Pilotprojekte, von Arbeitspaketen und Meilensteinen über Budgets und Berichtspflichten bis zu Kooperationsverträgen, Datenschutz und Förderrichtlinien.

Förderung und Akquise:  Du findest passende Förderprogramme auf Landes-, Bundes- und EU-Ebene, entwickelst Projektideen mit Partnern und schreibst Skizzen und Anträge.

Das bringst du mit

Studium:  Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem ingenieur-, natur- oder datenwissenschaftlichen Fach, z. B. Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Versorgungstechnik, Bauphysik, Physik, Mathematik oder Informatik.

Forschungserfahrung:  Du hast mehrere Jahre in der angewandten Forschung gearbeitet, etwa an einem Fraunhofer-Institut, einer anderen Forschungseinrichtung, einer Hochschule oder in einer F&E-Abteilung, idealerweise im Umfeld Gebäude, Energie oder TGA.

Methodik und Daten:  Du hast Studien od

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team.  Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers.  We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions.  This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes.  What You'll Be Doing

Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes. Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, including regulatory guidance and its practical application within commercial organisations. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun  Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.  Warum es diese Rolle braucht  Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.  Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.  Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.  Was du bewegen wirst

Partnerschaften gestalten:  Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

Menschen erreichen und aktivieren:  Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

Projekte ins Rollen bringen:  Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

Wirkung sichtbar machen:  Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

Dinge besser machen:  Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst  Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

Arbeit, die etwas

jobs.title: Projektmanager TGA / MEP (m/w/d) - Remote (DE)
jobs.description:

together. At Ruby, we keep breaking new ground.

du bist ein Profi, wenn es um die  Planung und Magie hinter den Kulissen  geht? neue Wege  und schaffen so eine zeitgemäße und bezahlbare Form von Luxus. Unser in München bündelt hierbei alle Bau- bzw. Design-, Verwaltungs- und Vermarktungsfunktionen sowie viele aus dem Hotel ausgelagerte Front Office Tätigkeiten.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About Retorio  Most AI companies are trying to replace people, but Retorio does the opposite. Based in Munich and spun out of TU Munich, the team builds an AI coaching platform that helps salespeople and service teams at global enterprises like Vodafone, Merck, and Daimler Truck master the human side of selling. The platform simulates realistic client conversations, analyzes behavior against a scientifically validated framework, and coaches reps into trusted advisors who win deals.  Your responsibilities  As a Product Engineer at Retorio, you will build and shape the AI coaching platform in a hybrid work environment with a 40-hour work week. Your role directly contributes to delivering impactful, scalable, and measurable AI sales coaching to enterprise clients.  What you will do

Own the frontend: architecture, code quality and technical direction for our product apps making the call on frontend architecture trade offs and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on.

Build end to end features as needed to support your frontend work.

Own product metrics for the areas you work on: activation, engagement, retention and session completion

Work closely with the PM to shape the problem, then own the solution and the scope with little oversight

Ship using agentic coding tools with spect driven development as your default way of working, from implementation to review and automation, and help the team get more out of them

Set up tracking before you ship, then report what changed after release

Mentor other engineers and raise the bar on code and product quality.

Talk to reps, managers and customer success to understand how the platform is used for.

Who you are:

3+ years building web products.

Hands on experience building with Agents

Full stack experience with a strong frontend

An eye for design: you notice spacing, hierarchy and flow, and can turn a rough idea into a clean, usable interface. Show us examples

Strong product analytics skills and a solid understanding of product funnels: you set up tracking, find where users drop off, write SQL and use the numbers to decide what to build next

Interest in why we build something, as well as how

Benefits  Retorio provides a company laptop and company stock options. You can work with flexible hours and take advantage of home office arrangements. Pets are allowed in the workspace. Commuting is supported with public transportation benefits and travel expenses compensation.

jobs.title: CDI - Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist - Strategy & Consulting - Paris
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?


Artefact est un cabinet de conseil international spécialisé en Data et Intelligence Artificielle, présent dans plus de 20 pays avec plus de 2 500 collaborateurs.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans leur transformation en combinant expertise technologique, conseil et connaissance métier, sur des enjeux allant de la stratégie Data & IA à la conception et au déploiement de solutions concrètes.

Nos équipes réunissent notamment des Business Consultants, Data Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers, qui interviennent auprès de grands groupes internationaux dans des secteurs variés.

Notre ambition : mettre la Data et l’IA au service de problématiques business concrètes et créer un impact mesurable pour nos clients.

Ton rôle

Au sein de l’équipe Talent Acquisition France et sous la responsabilité de la Head of Talent Acquisition, tu pilotes en autonomie le recrutement des équipes Strat Data d’Artefact, sur des profils allant de Junior à Manager.

Partenaire des équipes opérationnelles, tu les accompagnes tout au long du processus afin de garantir des recrutements de qualité et une expérience candidat exigeante :

Piloter les recrutements de bout en bout

  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins auprès des managers
  • Définir et mettre en œuvre l’approche de recrutement adaptée à chaque besoin
  • Piloter l’ensemble du processus : sourcing, qualification, entretiens RH, coordination des étapes d’évaluation et offre
  • Développer une approche proactive du sourcing et constituer des viviers de profils pertinents.

Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles

  • Conseiller et challenger les managers tout au long du processus afin de garantir des décisions de recrutement objectives et cohérentes
  • Garantir la bonne application du processus et des méthodes d’évaluation
  • Veiller à une expérience de recrutement de qualité pour les candidatures et les équipes internes

Contribuer à l’amélioration continue

  • Identifier les points de friction et contribuer à l’amélioration des processus et pratiques
  • Veiller à la qualité et à la fiabilité des données dans notre ATS (Greenhouse)
  • Contribuer aux projets et initiatives de l’équipe Talent Acquisition.

Ton profil

  • Une expérience confirmée en recrutement, idéalement dans le conseil/ ESN
  • Une maîtrise du recrutement de bout en bout, avec une solide pratique du sourcing et de l’approche directe
  • Une capacité à gérer et prioriser un périmètre de recrutement en autonomie
  • Une posture de business partner, avec la capacité de conseiller et challenger
  • Une bonne maîtrise des outils de recrutement et un bon niveau d’anglais.

Mission

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.

Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.
  • Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.
  • Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.
  • Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.
  • Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.
  • Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.
  • Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.
  2. Votre code est testé et maintenable.
  3. Les coding agents font

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. Role Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Director to lead our Enterprise Reporting and Analytics Engineering organization, a team of analytics engineers, report developers, visualization specialists, and people leaders. This organization focuses on the last mile of the enterprise data supply chain: the semantic models, curated data products, metric definitions, and consumption experiences that turn engineered data into decisions.

This is not a traditional reporting leadership role; the classic notion of “reporting” in the form of a myriad of dashboards and filters is racing towards obsolescence. But the need for data and insights, and the need to deliver it in a way that is digestible and actionable, is timeless. Yes, governed dashboards and trusted reporting remain the foundation, and this leader must be excellent at that foundation. But the mandate is to move the organization decisively beyond static reporting toward a proactive, intelligent analytics capability: partnering with Data Science to productize and visualize their models, enabling generative AI and LLM-based access to our data, building exception-based systems that alert users when outcomes deviate from expectation in a statistically meaningful way, and designing agents that monitor data continuously and deliver insight without being asked.

Analytics engineering shares much of its DNA with data engineering — modeling, transformation, testing, version control, CI/CD, performance and cost discipline — but is oriented toward business enablement rather than platform and pipeline. Success in this role therefore depends as much on partnership as on technical depth. This leader will work shoulder to shoulder with Data Engineering on the boundary between platform and consumption, with Product Management on roadmap and requirements, with Data Science on advanced analytic products, and with Analytics Operations on a disciplined intake and prioritization process that makes the best possible use of finite capacity.

jobs.description:
Overview

We have an opportunity for a Principal Engineer in our AI & Algorithms department, working with a particular focus on our defence and security clients. You’ll join a team of talented engineers and scientists designing, building and testing intelligent systems that require cutting edge algorithms.

As one of the senior technical voices in the team, you’ll be architecting the algorithmic approach on our projects, setting the technical bar for others, and helping shape the work we deliver. As well as hands-on engineering, you’ll spend time with clients, using your expertise to win new projects as well as deliver them. You’ll work in multidisciplinary teams that use our labs and computing resources to enable us to deliver ambitious projects.

Much of our defence and security work requires security clearance, so we ask for it up front. You won’t work exclusively in that sector, but a genuine interest in it matters to us.

We offer a flexible approach to hybrid working, although some of the projects you will be working on will require full-time working in the office.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Applying data-driven software development in machine learning/AI, applied statistics, and sensor processing, alongside mathematical computing techniques such as digital signal processing, simulation, and numerical optimisation.
  • Acting as technical lead and architect on our larger, more complex projects, owning the technical solution and the value it delivers to the client.
  • Setting technical direction and acting as technical reviewer across the department, with your opinion sought by colleagues.
  • Leading the development of proposals and costed work programmes, turning client problems into work we can win and deliver.
  • Driving internal capability and demonstrators that keep us at the leading edge and open up new conversations with clients.
  • Mentoring engineers and conducting technical interviews to help us recruit and grow strong people.
  • Contributing to how the department works, improving our processes and technical standards.

What you need to succeed:

  • 5+ years’ experience designing and delivering cutting edge algorithms for intelligent systems, including working on defence or security projects.
  • Technical skills in one or more of: transformer models, diffusion models, reinforcement learning, machine vision and perception.
  • A strong undergraduate degree in a relevant technical subject, such as AI/machine learning, computer science, mathematics or, physics. A PhD in a relevant subject is welcome but not required; deep, demonstrable industrial expertise is what matters.
  • Strong Python and software engineering judgement.
  • The ability to architect the technical approach on complex projects and to review the work of others,

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services)
jobs.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role  The Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services) will design, build, and operate the software services that run on UFORCE’s uncrewed vehicles — spanning video streaming, telemetry, autonomy integration, vehicle control, health monitoring, navigation, and device integrations.  You will turn independently evolved services into one secure, testable, and maintainable onboard platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on production Python services, service architecture, messaging, and reliable operation on constrained Linux hardware, including Raspberry Pi, x86, and NVIDIA Jetson.  You will also own the boundary between the vehicle and the backend: clear, versioned contracts with cloud services, deployment systems, video infrastructure, and operator interfaces that work over intermittent, low-bandwidth links. Working with backend, autonomy, hardware, QA, and field teams, you will make releases predictable and catch failures on the bench, not in the field.  What you’ll do

Define and evolve a unified onboard service architecture: service boundaries, messaging, configuration, startup ordering, readiness, watchdogs, and graceful degradation when dependencies or devices are unavailable.

Build and migrate production services to shared patterns, using reusable libraries and a reference service template covering project structure, packaging, logging, health reporting, and lifecycle management.

Standardise local service communication around NATS, with clear rules for integrating MAVLink, ZMQ IPC, and HTTP where appropriate.

Design stable, versioned vehicle-to-backend contracts for telemetry, commands and acknowledgements, video metadata and control, configuration, health, and logs.

Engineer for unreliable connectivity: buffering and store-and-forward, idempotent commands, explicit acknowledgements and timeouts, reconnection, back-off, and safe behaviour when the backend is unreachable.

Implement secure-by-default services: least-privilege identities and messaging permissions, mutually authenticated and encrypted backend links, secure credential provisioning and rotation, sandboxed runtimes, and audit events for safety-critical commands.

Strengthen automated testing across unit, contract, integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, with CI gates that catch regressions before release.

Build safer release workflows

jobs.title: Robot Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through  Rohlik.cz ,  Knuspr.de ,  Kifli.hu ,  Gurkerl.at  and  Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.  We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.  We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

The capture spec.  Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

Ground truth.  Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

The evaluation harness.  The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

The first training runs.  Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

Judgment before spend.  The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

3+ years of relevant full-time robotics experience.

PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry.  Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

You can read a paper and reproduce it.  Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

You know what policies train on.  Familiar with the current robo

You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric. About the Role
 Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.  We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

Data nobody else has:  Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

An open problem:  Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure:  Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

Publishing and open source:  We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

Compute:  GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

Hi 👋 we’re Genio. We create beautifully simple learning tools that boost knowledge, skills, and confidence.

  • We’re a SaaS scale up - there’s 90+ of us around the UK with our HQ in Leeds.

  • We’re driven achieve our mission to support 1 million students to become better learners by 2030.

🚀 About the role

Career track: IC4

Unit: Shared Services

Genio has given everyone access to Claude, but most of what makes AI work across a company doesn’t exist here yet: connections to our business systems, a shared skills library, people in each team who can help their colleagues, and the checks that keep it safe. This role designs and builds that system, then gets every team using it.

It’s a hands-on building role. We buy and configure leading platforms rather than build our own agent infrastructure, and you’ll write code and build custom integrations wherever configuration isn’t enough. Success is measured by how well other teams build and run their own workflows.

You will be responsible for:

  • Design. You design how our AI platforms, connectors, skills and agents fit together. You track what’s changing in AI tools, recommend platform and model choices to the Head of BizOps, and judge new tools on measured performance, reliability, security and cost.
  • Build and run. You build and maintain the integrations and agents that connect our AI platforms to business systems such as our CRM and our documentation, communication and finance tools. You’re responsible for the health of the whole system: spotting failures and out-of-date skills, and tracking use and cost by team so they can be recharged and reported. Champions answer first-line questions and IT handles access, while you handle escalations and fix root causes so problems don’t come back.
  • Knowledge. You build and look after the skills library and the shared knowledge our AI tools draw on: where it lives, how it’s organised, and how it’s kept current and correctly permissioned. You spot good workflows in one team, refine them and make them available to everyone, and decide which become company standards. The teams that own content keep it up to date.
  • Adoption. You train people at every level of technical skill and build a network of champions, nominated by their function heads, so every team has someone nearby to ask. You work alongside teams as they redesign processes, bringing the options for what can be automated, and share practice with engineering in both directions. You also report, team by team, where use is growing, where it’s slow and which uses are producing value.

jobs.title: AI Reliability Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
The role

Run the day-to-day operation of an AI Reliability Engineering team of eight to ten engineers across EMEA. You own the people, the queue, the rota, and the escalations. You report to the AIR Senior Manager for EMEA, who holds strategy, budget, and the senior customer relationships, so your time goes on running a world-class operation and growing the engineers in it.

The estate is about 29,000 GPUs today, with a planning target of one million by the end of 2027. You are the first manager hired under the Senior Manager, and as the region grows you take ownership of a full pillar with its own queue and SOPs. It is a hands-on role: close enough to GPUs, Linux, and high-performance fabrics to lead an incident and challenge a diagnosis, while leading the team most of the week.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead a team of eight to ten AI Reliability Engineers: 1:1s, objectives, reviews, probation, development, and hiring
  • Own the queue: prioritization, SLA adherence, MTTR, and backlog, with a named owner on every near-breach ticket and clean handoffs to Engineering and vendors
  • Run the rota and on-call for the team within the EMEA coverage model and the global follow-the-sun handover
  • Be the first management escalation point on P1s and customer escalations, lead post-incident reviews, and turn repeat incidents into problem records and durable fixes
  • Own the SOPs for your pillar and drive them into Nscale's automation so that repeatable remediation needs less human time
  • Work the day-to-day relationships with DC Operations, Network Operations, Engineering, and the fleet tooling and automation teams
  • Report your team's numbers weekly and accurately, and explain what moved and why

About you

  • Experience: 6+ years in infrastructure, operations, or support engineering in production environments, including 2+ years around GPU, HPC, or large data center estates
  • Leadership: 3+ years managing engineers in an operational support function, owning reviews, development plans, and performance management through to outcome
  • Operational ownership: you have run a queue against SLAs and are comfortable being accountable for the numbers
  • Communication: clear, specific, and concise, in writing and in person
  • Decisiveness and pragmatism: you make calls with incomplete information, improve process without slowing delivery, and commit once the decision is made
  • Technical foundation: solid production Linux and networking, working knowledge of how GPU fleets fail and get repaired, ITIL and SRE habits, and enough scripting to review an engineer's work
  • Adaptability: comfortable with out-of-hours escalations, on-call, and travel to data centers and customer sites

Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.  You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Senior Sensor Engineer (Tactile & Proprioception) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will build the neural architecture of physical touch and spatial awareness that gives our robotic hands human-like dexterity.  You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines.  Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control.

What you will do:

Own the sensing architecture.  Lead the evaluation, selection, and overall design of tactile and proprioceptive sensing systems across fingers, palm, and joints—built for modularity across product variants, not a one-off prototype.

Develop tactile array hardware.  Design and prototype high-resolution tactile sensors (optical, capacitive, piezoresistive, or magnetic) tailored for space-constrained, contact-rich finger pads and palm surfaces.

Engineer proprioceptive feedback.  Implement joint- and drive-level feedback mechanisms, including high-precision position/angle sensing, strain gauge force bridges, load cells, and tendinous tension tracking.

Design readout electronics & AFEs.  Build low-noise analog front-ends (AFEs), signal conditioning circuits, and local readout hardware optimized for minimal latency, wide dynamic range, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference (EMI).

Build calibration & processing pipelines.  Implement automated calibration protocols, thermal/drift compensation matrix algorithms, and feature extraction (e.g., slip detection, contact point estimation) to feed clean telemetry to the software stack.

Characterize & validate on real hardware.  Own sensor testing on custom rigs—evaluating dynamic response, force linearity, hysteresis, spatial resolution, and long-term mechanical wear over hundreds of thousands of cycles.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.

jobs.title: C++ Software Engineer (m/f/d) Platform Infrastructure
jobs.description:

  • Platform Development: Develop and maintain modern C++ software components for the robot's Linux-based platform infrastructure.
  • Communication & IPC: Build and maintain the IPC and communication interfaces that connect robot applications, backend services, and hardware-facing components.
  • Debugging & Diagnostics: Debug concurrency, timing, memory, performance, and system-integration issues across the platform.
  • Testing Infrastructure: Build unit, integration, and hardware-oriented test infrastructure for platform components.
  • Reliability & Observability: Improve system reliability through better diagnostics, logging, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Hardware Integration: Test and integrate software on real robotic hardware, working with firmware, control, backend, QA, and DevOps engineers when problems cross those boundaries.

  • Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience, with initial professional experience building production C++ software, typically up to about three years and excluding internships or working-student positions.
  • Modern C++: Hands-on experience writing C++ using modern practices (C++17/C++20), gained through professional work, internships, or substantial project experience.
  • Systems Programming: Working understanding of Linux system programming — processes, threads, synchronization, IPC, and sockets — along with asynchronous programming concepts.
  • Debugging: Practical debugging experience using tools such as GDB, sanitizers (ASan/TSan/UBSan), or Valgrind, applied to problems that span multiple interacting software or hardware components.
  • Testing: Experience writing automated tests with frameworks such as GoogleTest, including meaningful unit and integration test coverage.

Beneficial Skills

  • Robotics & Industrial Background: Experience with robotics, industrial automation, or embedded systems, including industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, CAN, or similar.
  • Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing: Experience with hardware-in-the-loop, simulation, fault-injection, or other automated system-testing approaches.

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:

  • Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

The Role

As cyber threats grow increasingly sophisticated, Yubico remains the proven standard in hardware-rooted, phishing-resistant security, trusted across the world’s leading technology firms, financial institutions, and critical infrastructure. We are seeking an experienced Sales Director based in the United Kingdom (UK) to lead high-velocity enterprise expansion and secure strategic net-new accounts across the UK. jobs.title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Mission  Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released  Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture  At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.  We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role  As an  AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d),  you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.  Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.  Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.  We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.  If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

Why this role exists

Every foundation model lab is solving the same problem: build more capability. Almost nobody is solving the harder one — what happens when that capability meets a real organisation and real people who have to relearn how they work. That's  the adoption layer , still wide open, and Multiverse sits in the unique position to solve this problem with ten years of proprietary learner and employer data driven from 1,500+ companies that no one else has.  Diagnose & Prescribe ( D&P ) is the engine room of that problem. It works out what a learner or employer actually needs, then decides what they get funded for and which apprenticeship or learning path they're pointed to next. D&P is how we assess a learner's or employer's skill gaps, decide what they need, and point them to the right apprenticeship or learning path — so the blast radius here is human and financial, not just a dashboard metric.  The line between leading this team and building the product has already blurred, which is why this role exists as it does. We need a leader who stays close enough to the work to have credible judgment in it, and who builds a high-trust team where diverse perspectives actually make the problem-solving better.  This is a broad, domain-coherent, event-driven and increasingly AI-native estate. The dominant challenge isn't deep algorithmic difficulty in any single repo — it's holding the whole D&P picture, sequencing work across varied services, and keeping load-bearing decisions safe as the system evolves underneath you.

What you're signing up for

A genuinely unsolved problem  — the constraint here is people and adoption, not model capability.

High agency.  We set outcomes, not playbooks. You and your team define how this evolves.

Real commercial breadth.  This team sits at the intersection of Produc

jobs.title: Senior Integration Software Engineer

We are looking for an experienced  Senior Integration Software Engineer  to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

jobs.title: Senior Identity Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Identity Security Engineer to join our Information Security team on a remote basis or hybrid basis if located in Barcelona. This is a hands-on engineer who will build identity controls that reduce excessive privilege and protect critical operations. You will improve access across employee, player, business partner, and non-human identities by building AI-native identity workflows: agentic systems that handle provisioning, access reviews, and remediation within explicit guardrails, with humans approving what matters. Your work will protect the identities and access that support Scopely’s critical business processes, including essential enterprise functions and game operations. This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Reduce identity attack surface and privilege

  • Reduce standing and excessive access with least-privilege roles, just-in-time and time-bound elevation, and automated access reviews.
  • Build repeatable identity and access workflows that make onboarding, approvals, role changes, reviews, and offboarding consistent, traceable, and timely.
  • Govern non-human identities, including service accounts, workload identities, CI/CD identities, API credentials, and AI agents and their tool integrations: inventory them, assign owners, replace long-lived secrets with short-lived or federated credentials, and rotate or revoke on a schedule and on signal.

Strengthen identity protection and resilience

  • Protect access to critical business processes and systems with phishing-resistant authentication (passkeys/FIDO2), device trust and posture signals, tightly controlled privileged access, and prompt revocation of suspicious sessions or compromised credentials.
  • Threat-model identity platforms, integrations, and access paths to identify exploitable trust relationships, privilege escalation, and credential misuse.
  • Build identity telemetry and response workflows to detect risky sign-ins, privilege changes, credential misuse, and compromised integrations.
  • Design and test break-glass and recovery procedures for identity services and cloud access so teams can regain secure access during an outage or compromise.
  • Extend the same patterns to player and partner identities where security owns the controls: platform identity federation (Apple, Google, Steam, console), account linking and recovery, external and vendor access, and defenses against account takeover and credential stuffing.

Build A

jobs.title: Anthropic Fellows Program, The Anthropic Institute (Economics & Policy)
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

Submit your application to the Economics & Policy workstream at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Weekly stipend of 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Substantial funding for compute and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. We may ask for references later in the process as well.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

In this role, you will analyse security events, investigate potential threats, validate and manage high-priority incidents, and execute decisive containment actions to minimise overall impact while escalating unresolved incidents to security engineering teams.

About Playson

Playson builds premium casino games and platform solutions for operators worldwide. Our products reach millions of players across regulated markets, and we ship frequently - which means our certification and compliance evidence has to be as well-engineered as the games themselves.

We are hiring a Software Developer, Compliance, to own that engineering: a pipeline that lets us ship faster and safer, and a defence of the platform and the games that holds up in front of a lab, an ISO assessor, and a future SOC 2 auditor.

About the role

You are a software developer sitting inside compliance. You will build and continuously evolve a secure compliance pipeline so we can ship games and platform changes faster and safer - and you will be the technical person who defends what we shipped when an auditor, a certification lab, or a regulator asks.

The scope is not games alone. You will stand in front of game certification labs, and you will also defend the platform: ISO certification of our systems and the evidence work that leads into a future SOC 2 audit. In every case, the job is the same. You produce the proof. You walk the auditor through it. You answer the question that was asked, with the evidence that was requested, and you stop there.

You will own the technical side of game certification. You take a game math package from the review channel to the lab, you produce the evidence the lab needs - build hashes, PAR sheets, configuration snapshots, version manifests - and you answer the lab's technical questions yourself, without a developer sitting next to you. When a certificate comes back, you are the person who confirms every deficiency is closed before the game is allowed past the pre-release gate.

Between lab submissions, you treat the pipeline as a product. Manual evidence collection, one-off screenshots, and tribal knowledge are the things you replace. You automate controls, tighten the audit trail, and shorten the path from "ready to ship" to "ready to show an auditor" without weakening the bar. Faster and safer at the same time is the point of this role - not one at the expense of the other.

You are a developer first.  3+ years writing production code, comfortable reading someone else's codebase and forming your own opinion about what it does. You are not a documentation coordinator who learned some technical words

We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You'll support product quality for an FDA-cleared, AI-driven clinical platform, from complaint investigation once it's live in hospitals, to the quality system and regulatory record that hold it all together.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. That software is a real advantage, but it's also the hardest part of the business to change safely, so good ideas often wait months or even years for the systems to catch up.  Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it, and Conduct is building the operating system for it. We read a company's code and processes, work out what needs to change, and help the business and its systems move forward together, wherever custom software has become too complex to change safely. jobs.title: Stage: Optimalisatie Processen Industry
jobs.description:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten:

Klantcompleetheid verbeteren 
Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen.

Transportkosten reduceren 
Analyseer transportkosten en routes, onderzoek de beladingsgraad en leverfrequenties en breng mogelijke kostenbesparingen in kaart.

Doorlooptijden magazijn verbeteren 
Breng de magazijnprocessen in kaart, identificeer wachttijden en onnodige handelingen en werk verbeteringen uit om de doorlooptijd te verkorten.

Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie 
Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit.

Werkinstructies vouwers en inpak verbeteren 
Beoordeel de huidige werkinstructies en onderzoek hoe deze eenvoudiger, duidelijker en visueler kunnen worden gemaakt voor medewerkers.

Wat bieden wij?

Stagevergoeding:

€ 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

€ 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains.

Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios.

 Duration:  6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027.

Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario.

Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario.

Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets.

Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort).

This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting our Product Managers and their engineering teams. jobs.title: Lead Systems Designer - Star Trek Fleet Command
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Lead Systems Designer to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team in Dublin on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day – whether in our work environments alongside talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of players around the world daily.

Star Trek Fleet Command is a standout success in the gaming industry. Launched in 2018, our in-house developed 4X MMO has continually evolved, earning its place as one of the top-grossing games on the market. Our next chapter is bold: we’re evolving the traditional 4X experience in STFC — and we need a bold design leader to shape the content and loops our players engage with on a daily basis.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Designer on STFC, you’ll own the standards, direction, and experiences that define how millions of players experience growth and mastery across our monthly content releases and beyond.

  • Become the design owner and leader behind the feature pipeline, directing designers and UX specialists in crafting compelling experiences for our players
  • Guide teams through the creative process, ensuring they can hit the vision of the game and deliver upon player and product needs with accuracy
  • Get your hands dirty through direct involvement in building and refining novel gameplay experiences focused on resource generation, spending, time gating, and power growth
  • Create systems that foster meaningful player agency and long-term investment
  • Manage and mentor designers in systems and economy design to elevate our standards and craft incredible experiences
  • Shape the design process to ensure the standards of players are met and exceeded
  • Use tools (Excel, Google Sheets) to model economies and progression pacing
  • Collaborate with Experienced, driven and passionate Designers, Product Managers, Analysts, and Engineers to implement features which aim to advance the genre
  • Evaluate performance using data, player feedback, and your own playtest experience
  • Design for scale: plan for long-term content extensibility and system health

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of game design leadership experience
  • Proven experience in F2P systems design and progression modelling
  • 8+ years of experience designing systems or economies for live, F2P games (preferably MMO, 4X, or strategy genres)
  • Confident people manager and mentor, that is able to grow & nurture talent
  • Experience with all aspects of game design discipline: concept, game progression, interface, monetization, and retention
  • A proven track record of delivering features that balance player fun, engage

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.

Why Marketplace Economics?

  • Real-world scale: Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users.
  • Complex markets, rich signals: Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response.
  • Strategic ownership: Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace.
  • Impact meets innovation: Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.

You will:

  • Design Economic Systems

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day.  Customer.io  powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Lauren, Senior Manager of Customer Success at  Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Mid-Market, APAC or EMEA team.

You'll own the success of a dedicated portfolio of roughly 40-60 Mid-Market customers — acting as their strategic advisor from onboarding through long-term adoption, and driving commercial outcomes across your book of business. You'll partner closely with Account Management, Technical Support, Product, Solutions, and Engineering to help customers realize real value throughout their lifecycle.

About the role

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

You Will:

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.
  • Define and lock down every communication path in and out of the sandbox: syscalls, IPC, shared memory, file descriptors, sockets, brokers, and minimize what each one exposes.
  • Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.
  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.
