jobs.title: Security Engineer, RF and Technical Surveillance Countermeasures
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Part of that footprint is the radio spectrum around and inside each site: what transmits there, what listens there, and what the equipment itself gives off. You'll be the engineer who owns that domain end to end: on-site RF monitoring and detection, technical surveillance countermeasures (TSCM) and emanations security, from the threat basis through the systems that make the spectrum observable, to sign-off before a site opens.

The engineering is in the monitoring and in the tooling that proves the controls hold: the sensors, receivers and their placement, the site baselines, and the detection logic that turns a rogue transmitter or an unexpected emitter into an alert an analyst trusts. External specialist partners do the hands-on sweep and measurement work; you write the scope, direct them on site and decide whether their report stands. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, sensor health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations, construction and legal teams, and directly with site operators and landlords. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

  • On-site RF monitoring and detection: design and develop the monitoring at each site: sensor, receiver and antenna selection and placement, the spectrum monitoring architecture, site RF baselines and what keeps them current, and detections that reach the team's security monitoring platform as alerts analysts keep trusting

  • Tools, automation and AI agents: build the detection and classification tooling, the instruments and software for checks between sweeps, the findings and evidence records behind them, and the agents that triage alerts and watch sensor health. When a review keeps costing people

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the role

Go To Market ("GTM") Systems builds and runs the platform that Sales and contracting operate on, a production Salesforce org plus a growing portfolio of custom internal applications and agents. These systems process revenue-impacting transactions, guide critical business processes, and produce data the rest of the company runs on. Today the path from request, development, test, and pull request to production push is manual and slows the team down rather than speeding it up.

We are hiring a DevOps / AgentOps engineer to build and run that path. You will stand up and maintain an AI-first CI/CD pipeline covering both Salesforce and custom application code. This release pipeline will support three modes: fully agentic, human-in-the-loop, and AI-assisted. Anthropic is an unusual place to do this. Our own frontier models are part of the toolkit and the question we want you to answer is what a delivery system looks like when you design it for agents and humans working side by side rather than retrofitting agents into a pipeline built for humans alone.

You will work closely with a team of business systems analysts, software engineers, and integration engineers to develop the solution to accelerate their everyday work. The pipeline you build is the one path to production for a system under audit, so the guardrails, approvals, and audit trail are part of the product, not an afterthought.

  • Design, build, and operate the CI/CD pipeline for a production Salesforce org and a portfolio of custom internal applications, from branching and validation through deploy and rollback
  • Define how a change is classified and routed into an agentic, human-in-the-loop, or AI-assisted lane, what gates each lane passes through, and how a change escalates between lanes when validation fails or risk changes

  • Own environment strategy, secrets handling, deploy observability, and kill-switch and rollback mechanics across all three lanes

About the role

Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you'll own the AI behaviour of production systems our clients depend on, including the agents, evaluations, and backend integration behind them. You'll lead delivery for your workstream and act as the technical point of contact for clients on how their AI performs on live data.

What we look for

  • Backend engineering experience, with a track record of taking AI/ML systems into production and keeping them reliable
  • Experience owning the AI behaviour of a production system end to end, rather than delivering a component scoped by another team
  • Experience designing evaluations that tie model behaviour to real-world outcomes, and using them to catch regressions
  • Experience leading root-cause analysis on a production AI or ML system
  • Comfort working directly with clients, including explaining model behaviour and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience handling regulated or sensitive data and designing for auditability; sovereign or on-premise deployment experience is valuable

Where this role sits

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 사전 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > *과제 전형 > 인성검사 (Personality Assessment) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (2-3회) (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사

You'll lead a small team of builders and the human layer, internal specialists and outsourced partners, that handles what agents can't yet. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Deal Desk, Finance, Billing and Product Engineering.

This is a Claude-first role. You'll use Claude every day to do your own work, and the renewal function will be one of the clearest examples inside Anthropic of what AI-run operations look like.

What you'll own in your first year

  • The design of the renewal system: which work agents run end to end, which work goes to a person, and the handoff rules between them.
  • A standard renewal that needs no person: a Claude-generated offer in product ahead of term end, accepted and provisioned automatically, with anything outside guidance routed to a seller with a recommended quote.
  • The data the system runs on: contract, commit burndown and usage data clean enough that agents and people trust it, built with Billing and Finance.
  • Early-warning signals for consumption risk and commitment shortfall, and what happens when one fires.
  • The human layer: how internal specialists, outsourced partners and account teams work around the agents, and the measures they're held to.
  • The next large renewal cycles, run with fewer manual steps per renewal than today.
  • Weekly renewal and retention forecasts grounded in usage and contract data.
  • Executive renewal conversations on the largest and most complex accounts, alongside account teams.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • Owned renewal, retention or post-sale outcomes at large scale, either running the function or leading the product or service that runs it for other

jobs.title: Senior Scrum master
jobs.description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.  Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen,  wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.  Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.

Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Many of the people who could gain the most from Claude are the least able to buy it the usual way. A teacher often pays for tools out of pocket. A small nonprofit has no procurement team. A university lab that wants to use Claude has to go through funding, an IT office, and a purchasing department at once. Beneficial Deployments works to reach them, through programs like Claude for Teachers and Claude for Nonprofits and through our work with researchers.

We're looking for engineers who find it deeply satisfying to remove the one thing stopping thousands of teachers or scientists from getting started. You'll work in other teams' codebases as often as our own, and much of the job is earning the trust of the engineers, accountants, and safety reviewers who own those systems. Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security and control commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. You will also work with GRC engineering to automate evidence collection and continuous monitoring, starting with ITGCs and extending into other areas of security and compliance. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

How do we know whether a model is safe - and how do we know whether the systems we built to catch misuse actually catch it?

Anthropic answers both questions with evaluations. We measure model behavior across misuse, prompt injection, and user well-being to inform training and deployment decisions. We also use AI to investigate potential misuse of Claude, analyzing real-world traffic to surface bad actors and emerging threats that drive enforcement actions. Neither is worth much unless the evaluations behind them are representative, robust, and trustworthy.

This role builds the methods and infrastructure that make them so. Sitting at the intersection of applied ML research and engineering, you'll design experiments to improve how we evaluate both model behavior and the agentic systems that govern it, build datasets that represent real abuse rather than clean approximations of it, and ship those methods into the pipelines that gate model training, agent changes, and launch decisions.

Responsibilities

Evaluation research and methodology. Design and run experiments to improve evaluation quality — developing methods to generate representative test data, simulate realistic user behavior, and validate grading accuracy. Research how different factors (multi-turn conversations, tools, long context, user diversity) impact model safety behavior. Analyze evaluation coverage to identify measurement gaps, and evolve evals so they remain unsaturated and high-signal as model and agent capabilities advance.

Agentic investigation evals. Build and own the evaluation harness for an agentic investigation system — defining metrics, test cases, and grading approaches for a complex, long-horizon agent. Measure agent performance end-to-end (detection precision and recall, investigation quality, robustness) and drive hill-climbing on the hardest harm areas. Construct RL environments to improve Claude's safety investigation capabilities.

Datasets grounded in real harm. Construct high-quality eval datasets representing real-world misuse across harm areas such as cyber attacks, bio weapons, and influence operations, drawing from both real traffic patterns and synthetic generation. Collaborate with Policy and Enforcement to translate observed harm patterns into measurable evaluations.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Senior Engineer on the Life Sciences team, you'll build biology software that our own scientists and the wider research community can depend on, and you'll be one of the main people representing that work to computational biologists outside Anthropic.

The Life Sciences team works to accelerate progress in biology with AI, combining frontier models with hands-on computational and experimental research. We want the tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks we build in genomics and structural biology to be useful beyond our own projects, so we plan to release them to the community. Computational biology has a long tradition of open, shared software, and we want to contribute to it well. Every release should be something a researcher can install, run on their own data, and trust: correct on real inputs, validated against reference data and established methods, documented, versioned, and maintained after launch.

You'll own that standard. You'll write a large share of the code yourself, decide when something is ready to ship, and stay with it once people start using it. You'll also be an active member of the biology software community: maintaining public repositories, answering issues, speaking at conferences and workshops, and bringing what you hear from researchers back into what we build next.

We use Claude and AI coding agents heavily to build software, and we expect you to do the same across design, implementation, testing, and review. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand: you should understand it, test it, and measure its performance before it ships. We're looking for someone with deep software engineering experience who already works this way.

The shape of the role is flexible. You might spend most of your time as an individual contributor, or you might lead a small group of engineers and scientists while continuing to contribute directly. Your focus can be genomics, structural biology, or both. Experience in other areas of computational biology is welcome, and we expect the work to range more widely over time.

What matters most is a record of biology software that other people have adopted and relied on.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Graphics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Graphics Engineer. This role can be based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Portugal, Spain or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. If you're open to working in any of these locations, there's no need to apply more than once. We'll discuss location preferences during the hiring process. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location.

We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices.

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and optimize real-time rendering features on mobile platforms using Vulkan (Android) and Metal (iOS).

  • Work with clustered/meshlet-based geometry systems, implementing GPU-driven visibility, culling, and LOD.

  • Integrate and refine modern rendering techniques such as clustered/tiled lighting, temporal anti-aliasing (TAA), and super-resolution (TSR).

  • Assist in the development of real-time global illumination features in collaboration with senior technical staff, ensuring scalability across different device tiers.

  • Write and optimize shaders (HLSL/GLSL/MSL) for power-efficient mobile performance.

  • Profile GPU/CPU performance and analyze rendering bottlenecks using tools like RenderDoc, Perfetto, Xcode GPU Debugger, and Mali/Snapdragon profilers.

  • Contribute to GPU memory layout design, draw submission strategies, and render pass optimizations for tile-based GPUs.

  • Collaborate closely with engine and content teams to ensure visuals meet quality and performance goals across platforms.

  • Stay informed on industry rendering trends and suggest improvements to our pipeline.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of graphics programming experience, with a focus on mobile platforms.

  • Strong C++ skills with experience working in performance-critical rendering code.

  • Solid knowledge of Vulkan and/or Metal APIs.

  • Experience with Unity’s Scriptable Render Pipeline (SRP), including extending or customizing SRPs.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, AI Safety and Alignment
jobs.description:
Scale Labs, Research Scientist — AI Safety and Alignment

As the leading data and evaluation partner for frontier AI companies, Scale plays a central role in understanding and safeguarding AI systems. Building on this expertise, Scale Labs has launched a new team focused on technical AI safety and policy research, to bridge the gap between frontier AI research and policy, helping policymakers make informed, evidence-based decisions about AI capabilities and risks.

Our research tackles some of the hardest open problems in AI safety: assessing the alignment of frontier models, developing control protocols and monitoring methods, preserving the monitorability, understanding failure modes in multi-agent systems and recursive self-improvement. We collaborate closely with partners across industry, the public sector, and academia and regularly publish our findings. We are looking for talented researchers to join us in shaping this vision.

As a Research Scientist on this team, you will conduct research and build evaluations, tools, and datasets that help us understand and reduce risks from frontier AI systems. For example, you might do any or all of the following:

  • Design and stress-test control protocols and monitoring systems that detect and limit unsafe behavior by AI models and agents in deployment;
  • Build alignment evaluations that probe for deception, sabotage, scheming, reward hacking, and other misaligned behaviors;
  • Study monitorability, including whether a model’s reasoning stays faithful and legible enough to supervise, and how training methods and deployment practices can preserve or erode it;
  • Investigate risks that emerge when multiple AI agents interact, such as collusion, coordination failures and steerability;
  • Develop threat models and evaluations for AI systems that automate AI research and development, to track progress toward recursive self-improvement and inform preparedness planning;
  • Work with government agencies and other labs to scope and design evaluations that measure and mitigate risks from advanced AI;
  • Publish research and evaluation methodologies, and write technical reports for policymakers.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Commitment to our mission of promoting safe, secure, and trustworthy AI as capabilities continue to advance.
  • Practical experience conducting technical research collaboratively. You should be comfortable building and instrumenting ML pipelines, building evaluation harnesses, running experiments on frontier models and agents, and quickly turning new ideas from the research literature into working prototypes.
  • Familiarity with current research in at least one of the areas above.
  • A track record of published research in machine learning, particularly in AI safety and alignment.
  • At least three year

This is early, high-stakes research. The team is small, the problems are genuinely unsolved, and the work will matter.

We are looking for someone with deep expertise in both AI and at least one of: government, political science, or public policy. The ideal candidate understands the technical landscape well enough to reason about AI capabilities and risks, and understands democratic institutions well enough to see where those risks become structural threats.

Key responsibilities

Projects on this team are illustrative rather than fixed — we expect the research agenda to evolve as both AI capabilities and institutional pressures change. Current and expected focus areas include:

  • Making fundamental contributions to the development and expansion of our public data and research on how people use AI for politics, including regular reports and deep dives on elections and policy topics, and grow into leading this work over time
  • Designing and conduct empirical research on AI’s political effects, drawing on external data sources and the privacy-preserving measurement systems internally
  • Designing, running, and analyzing experiments on systems of many AI agents, testing whether and when tools from political economy (rules, monitoring, voting, dispute resolution) help agents govern themselves and stay under human oversight

  • Building and maintaining relationships with academic institutions, policy think tanks, and other research partners, and serve as the point of contact for outside researchers who use our data

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role

Most of what makes Together AI so valuable for customers is invisible from the outside. Optimizing kernels, scheduling, quantization, speculative decoding, and more create an industry-leading platform for inference and post-training at scale. As a technical marketing engineer, you are the conduit between the engineering and research work and the developers who should know about it. You go deep with product, engineering, research, and CX to learn the platform at the level of nuanced technical detail, then decide which details matter to an AI builder and build content that makes them care.

This is a creator role. You are a technical storyteller. You'll produce social-native posts, technical blogs, performance benchmarks, demo and explainer videos, and thought leadership, all aimed at one outcome: building Together’s credibility with developers. You'll also own our technical communities on X, YouTube, Discord, Linkedin and the engagement metrics for developer content company-wide, including amplifying the work of engineers and researchers who publish under their own names.

Responsibilities

External

  • Partner with product, engineering, DevRel, research, and CX to learn new capabilities in technical depth, then extract the most meaningful aspects for a developer audience.
  • Create the content strategy based on deep understanding of our company’s differentiation and marries that with an understanding of the content that would resonate.
  • Build technical content across formats: blogs, videos, benchmark reports, podcasts, and short-form posts that drive engagement with developers and preference for Together.
  • Monitor real-time news and announcements related to AI infrastructure and lead timely responses working with product and engineering
  • Replies to social media comments, bringing expert understanding of the technology
  • Own Together's presence in technical communities, primarily X, Discord, LinkedIn, and Youtube. Track engagement metrics, what lands, what doesn't, and adjust.
  • Drive amplification of engineering and research work across social channels.
  • Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community - understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
  • Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community
  • While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ DevRel teams

Internal

  • Be the bridge between research and engineering with the field team
  • Deploy models, benchmark new capabilities (e.g. the compiler, speculative decoding) across models and workloads, and turn results into practical field guidance

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Horizons

The Horizons team leads Anthropic's reinforcement learning (RL) research and development, playing a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to every Claude release, with significant impact on the autonomy, coding, and reasoning capabilities of Anthropic's models.

About the role

We're hiring for the Cybersecurity RL team within Horizons. As a Research Engineer, you'll help to safely advance the capabilities of our models in secure coding, vulnerability remediation, and other areas of defensive cybersecurity.

This role blends research and engineering, requiring you to both develop novel approaches and realize them in code. Your work will include designing and implementing RL environments, conducting experiments and evaluations, delivering your work into production training runs, and collaborating with other researchers, engineers, and cybersecurity specialists across and outside Anthropic.

The role requires domain expertise in cybersecurity paired with interest or experience in training safe AI models. For example, you might be a white hat hacker who's curious about how LLMs could augment or transform your work, a security engineer interested in how AI could help harden systems at scale, or a detection and response professional wondering how models could enhance defensive workflows.

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have experience in cybersecurity research.

  • Have experience with machine learning.

  • Have strong software engineering skills.

  • Can balance research exploration with engineering implementation.

  • Are passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing safe and beneficial systems.

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Professional experience in security engineering, fuzzing, detection and response, or other applied defensive work.

  • Experience participating in or building CTF competitions and cyber ranges.

  • Academic research experience in cybersecurity.

  • Familiarity with RL techniques and environments.

  • Familiarity with LLM training methodologies.

jobs.title: Hebrew Multimedia Content Reviewer (Part time)
jobs.description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a  Welo Global  brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

welocalize.com

MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB

In this exciting position, the Hebrew Multimedia Content Reviewer will be writing and reviewing linguistic content in a language which they have a native level proficiency to ensure the highest quality of accuracy for customers using the world's foremost multimedia platforms. With time the Multimedia Content Reviewer will become the cultural ambassador for their language market and will be expected to produce fully localized content and flag potential cultural issues with content types, wording and articulate suggestions to make all content appropriate and relevant for the target markets.

The ideal candidate possesses a background in journalism or similar, has proven creative writing skills, and a keen attention to detail. In addition to that, we’re seeking candidates that are passionate about music, film and tech and have a knack for iOS and Mac OS devices.

MAIN DUTIES

The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership of the  Multimedia Content Reviewer :

Localize, translate and adapt content of various categories (such as music, film, gaming and sports content) while adhering to writing style guide and guidelines

Write new copy for a range of multimedia products and services

Perform annotation tasks

jobs.title: AI Safety Residency - SLPreP
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs Preparedness and Policy (SLPreP), we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

The work includes thinking about various failure modes, evaluating whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Residents take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide AI safety residents on projects in AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AI systems, including monitoring their reasoning to detect harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment red-teaming: Developing science around testing whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: Examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: A benchmark with task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: evaluating whether language models choose harmful actions when given simulated dangerous tools under various operational pressures
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • RSI Control: evaluating whether frontier models can covertly sabotage R&D efforts in the RSI loop.

We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Scopely is looking for a Senior Client Engineer to join our Stumble Guys Team in a hybrid set up at our Dundee office.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — both through our work environment and through the strong connections we build with our player communities. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of players worldwide daily.

Stumble Guys is one of our most recent hits, with millions of fans joining the party every day and keeping the game at the top of the charts in more than 50 countries. Our ambition is to build a beloved franchise that players enjoy for many years to come.

What You Will Do

  • Ship production-grade mobile games used by millions of gamers
  • Drive the implementation of game mechanics and system processes using Unity and C#
  • Drive the development of big and complex new features or improvements to existing ones
  • Ensure technical performance (crash rates, FPS, startup times, CPU usage, etc) is healthy throughout the development
  • Collaborate and communicate with cross-functional departments including game design, product management, marketing, etc.
  • Think about and propose solutions to the challenging problems of game development

What We're Looking For

  • Strong knowledge of C# and/or C++, or other relevant game-programming language
  • Extensive experience and knowledge of game engines, in particular Unity or a similar technology (like Unreal Engine)
  • Knowledge of Photon Quantum is a plus
  • Strong understanding of the basics of software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, game framework architecture at scale, maintainability over time, robust API design, etc.
  • Solid understanding of mobile networking best practices: request limiting, request caching, batching, content aggregation, minification, integrating with rest and TCP/UDP services, etc.
  • Experience with asynchronous, multi-threaded, parallel programming paradigms and other techniques to maximize UI responsiveness and do operations in background
  • Experience and understanding around client-side testing, like unit, functional or integration testing
  • Strong knowledge of game programming fundamentals, common patterns, how systems work together and various common architectural approaches
  • Strong mobile experience (iOS and Android): ability to debug native device issues, strong understanding of hardware and platform limitations, performance metrics, etc.
  • Good understanding of tooling around game development, like Git, Jenkins for build automation, etc.
  • Enjoy solving complex technical problems, especially in large systems

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

jobs.description:
Head of Revenue Operations

Foundry | Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer | Location: [Boston / SF / Austin]

The Role

The Head of Revenue Operations is the CRO's commercial partner and the owner of the strategy, systems, data, and people that run Foundry's revenue engine from planning to pipeline to billing. You will make forecasting, quota setting, pipeline analysis, sales process, and sales stages consistent and trusted across Americas, EMEA, and APAC, for an established and growing business with a broad, multi-product portfolio.

What You'll Do

  • Be the CRO's commercial partner. Turn growth targets into operating plans: headcount and capacity modeling, segmentation, territories, account allocation, and rules of engagement, tied to pipeline, productivity, and retention. Build business cases for investment in people, tools, and process, and be willing to say no with clear reasoning.
  • Territory Planning. Support territory planning and analysis by evaluating market potential, identifying growth opportunities, and providing data-driven insights to optimize territory alignment and sales coverage.
  • Drive forecasting discipline. Own forecast methodology, pipeline inspection, and post-close, pre-live revenue forecasting. Run weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecast and business reviews, and deliver accurate, decision-ready reporting to the CRO and executive team.
  • Own pipeline analytics and sales process. Define and govern sales stages, qualification standards, and win-rate, velocity, and coverage metrics across advertising, custom content, events, and lead generation. Spot concentration risk in the top accounts and cross-sell and packaging whitespace across the portfolio.
  • Be the cross-functional conduit. Act as the single point of coordination across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Marketing, and Operations, improving handoffs from sale to execution to renewal and giving clients and internal teams a unified, 360-degree view of each account instead of fragmented reports.
  • Own the revenue tech stack. Own the CRM (HubSpot), order management (Boostr), CPQ/automation (DealHub), and the connected data stack. Set the roadmap, govern access and change management.
  • Put AI to work. Deploy and measure AI-assisted workflows for account research, data enrichment, pipeline inspection, product recommendations, and talk tracks, validating outputs and tracking adoption and impact. Help unlock Foundry's first-party data as a commercial asset.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

Scale's Global Public Sector team uses AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build AI that runs inside production systems used by national health and government organisations.

You'll own scoped components of those systems, such as a model integration, agent tool, API, data pipeline, or evaluation, from implementation through to delivery. Senior engineers set the system-level design and client commitments, so you can go deep on making your components work reliably on real data.

What you'll do

  • Own the implementation, testing, and delivery of defined AI components within an established system design
  • Build agent tools, model integrations, and the backend services and APIs they depend on
  • Run and extend evaluations within an established framework, interpret results, investigate common failure modes, and flag regressions
  • Debug production issues in the components you own and resolve them using the team's engineering practices
  • Communicate progress and blockers early, and take responsibility for delivery dates within your scope
  • Work directly with client teams on the requirements and feedback for your components
  • Share what you learn with the team as you build public sector domain expertise

What we look for

  • Experience building and shipping production software, with proficiency in Python and working knowledge of at least one of TypeScript, Java, or C++
  • Hands-on experience integrating models or AI/ML components into a production application, such as calling LLMs, building retrieval or agent tooling, or deploying a trained model
  • A working understanding of ML evaluation: how to read results, spot regressions, and identify common causes of model failure
  • Experience owning a defined piece of work through testing, release, and production debugging
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to iterating on models and datasets
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including raising blockers and trade-offs early

Nice to have

  • A backend or full-stack engineering background, so you can work across the API, service, and data-schema layers of the systems you contribute to
  • Experience with cloud ML platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Exposure to agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, or context engineering
  • Experience handling regulated or sensitive data

Where this role sits

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engine

Job Title: Patient Care Advocate

Job Location:  Remote

About Us:

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs.

Role Overview:

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment.

What You’ll Do:

Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility.

Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications.

Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable.

Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility.

Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤의 AI 기술을 실제 제품과 서비스로 연결하고, 새로운 사업 기회를 검증하고 확장하는 조직입니다. 여러 Squad가 서로 다른 고객과 시장을 대상으로 사업을 추진하며, 각 Squad는 제품 개발부터 서비스 운영과 사업 성과까지 책임집니다. 고객의 요구와 실제 사용 결과를 바탕으로 제품을 개선하고, 사업성이 확인된 서비스를 확장해 나갑니다.
  • AI Product Dev Chapter는 소속 엔지니어들의 기술 역량과 성장을 책임지는 조직입니다. 각 스쿼드의 PO가 제품과 사업을 이끌고, 챕터는 기술 방향·개발 품질·공통 기반·인재 육성을 맡습니다. 스쿼드가 개발·운영하는 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. 챕터의 목표는 스쿼드의 AI 기술이 고객 가치와 매출로 이어지는 속도를 높이는 것입니다.
  • 스쿼드가 만드는 AI 제품 중 일부는 실제 고객에게 출시해 운영하는 단계에 들어서고 있습니다. 고객 요구에 맞는 기능을 적시에 출시하려면 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 정하고, 제품 품질과 운영 비용을 고려해 기술적 병목을 해결해야 합니다. 챕터는 PO와 함께 이 과정을 이끌고, 여러 스쿼드에서 얻은 경험을 본부 공통의 개발 역량으로 발전시켜 갑니다.
  • 이번에 합류하실 분은 챕터장으로서 제품별 기술 의사결정과 공통 개발·검증 체계를 이끌고, 엔지니어를 채용·육성하며 챕터의 일하는 방식을 만들어 갑니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 제품 기술 의사결정: PO와 함께 고객 요구를 기술 과제로 구체화하고, 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 조율합니다. 스쿼드별 기술 스택이 파편화되지 않도록 각 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. PoC가 프로덕션 전환까지 이어지도록 중요한 기술 병목은 직접 설계 검토와 프로토타이핑에 참여해 해결합니다.
  • AI 기술 PoC와 품질 검증: 새로운 모델·API를 빠르게 비교 평가할 수 있는 PoC 환경을 만들고, AI 기능을 실제 사용 시나리오와 데이터로 평가합니다. 실패 사례와 변경 전후의 품질·응답 속도·비용을 비교해 제품 개선으로 연결합니다. 평가는 고객이 비용을 내고 쓸 품질인지까지 확인하고, 결과는 PO가 사업 판단에 쓸 수 있게 정리합니다.
  • AI 기반 개발 생산성: AI 코딩 도구가 코드베이스와 제품의 맥락, 개발 규칙을 이해하고 테스트 작성·배포 설정 같은 반복 작업을 맡을 수 있도록 개발 환경을 갖춥니다. AI가 만든 코드와 설계를 사람이 판단할 리뷰 기준을 세우고, 테스트 자동화로 빠르게 검증할 수 있게 합니다. 새로운 AI 개발 도구는 생산성·품질·보안 기준으로 평가해 도입하고, 구성원이 찾은 좋은 방법은 가이드와 세미나로 스쿼드 전체에 퍼뜨립니다.
  • 공통 개발·운영 기반: 반복 개발 비용을 줄이고 새 기능을 빠르게 출시할 수 있도록 개발 템플릿, CI/CD, 클라우드, 모니터링 등 공통 기반을 만듭니다. 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 적용 범위와 유지보수 담당을 정하고, 쌓이는 기술 부채를 찾아 해결합니다. 제품 출시와 운영을 위해 인프라·보안 등 다양한 부서와 협업해 안정성과 비용 효율을 높입니다.
  • 엔지니어 채용·성장·평가: 사업 계획에 필요한 엔지니어 역량을 정리하고, 이를 검증할 JD·기술 과제·면접 기준을 만들어 채용과 온보딩을 주도합니다. 정기 1on1·멘토링과 테크 토크·코드 리뷰로 구성원의 성장을 돕고 스쿼드 간 기술을 공유합니다. PO와 협력해 실제 기여에 근거한 성과 평가와 경력 개발을 이끕니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

    • 사업에 필요한 고객 접점, 기술, 데이터, 유통 역량을 가진 파트너를 발굴하고, 상호 이해관계를 반영한 협력 구조를 설계·실행합니다.
  • 사업모델 설계 및 매출 계약 리드
    • 고객 가치와 제공 비용을 바탕으로 사업모델과 가격 정책을 설계하고, 제안·협상·계약부터 후속 사업 확장까지 주도합니다.

Envato is an all-in-one creative asset toolkit built to help creative professionals thrive. We bring together world-class creative assets and AI tools to help creatives find what they need, explore ideas, refine their work and keep their creative momentum going.

And that makes designing Envato a little different.

Our customers are designers, filmmakers, editors and creators. And so are we. We use the same kinds of tools, wrestle with the same creative problems and care about the same details as the people we're building for. jobs.title: Creative Advisor - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI. As a Creative Advisor, you’ll bring your creative practice into direct collaboration with Scale’s research and ML teams. You’ll help them understand how work gets made in your field, develop new work together, and provide feedback on how AI models support—or fall short of—real creative processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Connect with other creators: Meet and learn from creatives and researchers across HFC and your industry.
  • Shape work in your domain: Share the taste, judgment, methods, and creative decisions behind your practice to help inform model development.
  • Create alongside the team: Collaborate on briefs and develop new work that helps explore what models can and cannot do in your field.
  • Partner with ML and research teams: Define what “good” looks like in your field, review model outputs, flag where AI falls short, and give feedback that shapes how models learn your craft.
  • Help peers understand the opportunity: Introduce other creators in your field to the program and share your experience contributing work.

Who Should Apply

We’re looking for leading creators in their field who are interested in shaping AI and how it’s changing creative work. No AI experience needed. Your expertise in your craft matters most, and being connected to others in your field is a plus. This is a paid, part-time role with a flexible schedule.

Why Join

  • Have a voice: Contribute your subject-matter expertise and perspective in your domain. Build the future by shaping frontier models.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with ML and research teams and connect with other leading creatives.
  • Explore new creative possibilities: Make new work through paid, commissioned briefs that challenge what models are capable of doing.
  • Get paid for your expertise: Paid $300 hourly, with compensation, time commitment, and project scope shared during your interview.

Application Process

  1. Apply: Share your background and a link to your portfolio. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
  2. Portfolio Review: Share one past project you’re proud of. Nothing is used without a signed agreement and payment, and we’ll follow up with next steps.
  3. Meet the Team: A paid conversation with our research and ML team to walk through your work.
  4. Get Started: Successful candidates are invited to join the Human Frontier Collective as a Creative Advisor.

Scale is accelerating the development of AI across the world's most important organizations. The Forward Deployed PM is the person who makes enterprise deployments succeed from the product side — embedded with customers, shaping real production outcomes, and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.

jobs.description:
About Scale AI

Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with the world's leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI transformation through frontier AI systems that solve real business problems.

Every day, we work with organizations across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, media and telecommunications to build production AI agents that automate complex workflows, help humans, reason over enterprise knowledge, and operate safely at scale.

The Opportunity

Applied AI is moving faster than ever. New foundation models, reasoning techniques, agent architectures, and research papers emerge every week. Yet building AI systems that reliably solve real-world problems remains one of the hardest engineering challenges.

As a Frontier Agent Engineer (Applied AI), you'll bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production deployment. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, evaluate, and deploy intelligent systems that combine frontier models with structured knowledge, retrieval, traditional machine learning, and enterprise software.

Unlike traditional ML roles that focus on a single model or product, you'll work across a diverse portfolio of AI challenges spanning multiple industries and use cases. You may build a multi-agent research system and then participate in designing a customer intelligence platform, a healthcare copilot, or an autonomous workflow for a Fortune 100 company.

If you enjoy reading new AI papers, experimenting with the latest models, and shipping production systems that create measurable business impact, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Build

Frontier AI Systems

  • Design and deploy production AI agents that leverage the latest advances in large language models, reasoning, retrieval, memory, and tool use.
  • Architect intelligent systems that combine LLMs, traditional machine learning, structured knowledge, enterprise data, and deterministic software into reliable production workflows.
  • Engineer customer intelligence layers, retrieval pipelines, memory systems, and knowledge representations that allow agents to reason over large, heterogeneous enterprise data.
  • Develop multi-agent systems that coordinate reasoning, planning, tool execution, and human oversight.
  • Translate frontier AI research into production systems by rapidly evaluating new models, prompting techniques, reasoning paradigms, and agent architectures.

Experimentation & Evaluation

  • Own the full experimentation lifecycle, from hypothesis generation to production rollout.

As Scale AI continues its historic growth trajectory in Generative AI, we are seeking a Growth Strategy & Operations Lead to help ensure our customer projects have the expert capacity they need to deliver on time. Growth at Scale is not traditional user acquisition: our team manages the supply side of Outlier, Scale’s expert contributor marketplace, sourcing, onboarding, activating, retaining, and routing highly skilled contributors such as PhDs, coders, and domain experts to the AI projects that need them most.

This demanding and multi-faceted role requires a unique blend of strategy, operations, and analytics. Reporting to the VP of Enterprise Sales, this role owns both halves of Scale AI’s enterprise revenue engine: the strategy that determines where we play and how we win, and the operating system - people, process, and systems - that makes that strategy executable, measurable, and repeatable.

jobs.description:
The goal of a Machine Learning Engineer at Scale is to leverage techniques in the fields of generative AI, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and agentic AI to improve Scale's products and customer experience in production environments. Our machine learning engineers take advantage of robust internal infrastructure and unique access to massive datasets to deliver improvements to our customers.

Our Public Sector Machine Learning team is focused on deploying cutting-edge models to mission-critical government systems through products like Donovan and Thunderforge. Our work spans multiple modalities, with a strong focus on both large language models and computer vision. On the LLM side, we are developing agentic systems that help solve complex operational and planning challenges for government partners. This includes building agent frameworks that integrate with custom retrieval pipelines and production APIs, as well as evaluation tools to benchmark and refine agent behavior. We're also advancing research in areas like reinforcement learning for agentic LLMs, with successful deployment into real-world operational environments. On the computer vision front, we're training advanced models to increase labeling throughput and automate perception tasks. Our efforts include building large-scale fine-tuning pipelines, training models across multiple modalities, and developing generalizable vision foundation models to support a wide range of defense applications.

You will:

  • Take state of the art models developed internally and from the community, use them in production to solve problems for our customers and taskers
  • Improve and maintain production models through retraining, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural updates, while preserving core performance characteristics
  • Collaborate with product and research teams to identify and prototype ML-driven product enhancements, including for upcoming product lines
  • Work with massive datasets to develop both generic models as well as fine tune models for specific products
  • Build scalable machine learning infrastructure to automate and optimize our ML services
  • Serve as a cross-functional representative and advocate for machine learning techniques across engineering and product organizations
  • Be comfortable learning new technologies quickly and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable with light travel (approximately 10%) for customer interaction and team needs

This role will require an active TS security clearance

jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise Core Platform
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is building the agentic operating system that powers AI deployment across the world's most important organizations. The Platform PM is the person who determines what that foundation needs to be — and holds the bar on how well it gets built.

This is not a roadmap PM, a program manager, or a feature tracker. The Platform PM owns the core infrastructure that every FD team builds on top of: defining the foundation before anything else can be built reliably, sequencing work against real customer commitments and FD team velocity, identifying which FD-built patterns are ready to graduate to core, and ensuring that every capability that ships does so at a bar customers can trust without thinking about it.

The best Platform PMs have defined platform capabilities at production bar in high-stakes environments and understand the difference between what is necessary to build, what is interesting to build, and what should never be built at all.

What You'll Do

  • Define the foundation. Determine what needs to be true at the core platform layer — across each capability pillar — before anything reliable can be built on top of it.
  • Sequence it. Prioritize and order platform work given customer commitments, FD team velocity needs, and what is actually blocking progress today. Getting this wrong means building on an unstable base or building the right things in the wrong order and paying for it in rework and FD team drag.
  • Identify patterns and graduate capabilities. Watch what FD teams are building across the application layer, determine what is genuinely repeating, and make the call on what moves to core — and when. Do not rush graduation or delay it out of caution.
  • Hold the quality bar. Every capability on the platform roadmap earns its place twice: once by being necessary, and again by being done well enough that customers trust it without thinking about it. Keep the platform from becoming a graveyard of half-built capabilities.
  • Unlock delivery team time to value. Forward deployed delivery teams should spend their time solving the hardest customer problems, not rebuilding plumbing on every engagement. That requires a platform that is secure by default, deployable anywhere, observable in production, and equipped with the agentic primitives, eval infrastructure, expert judgment capture, and data reasoning capabilities that every agent workload needs.
  • Partner across the organization. Work closely with platform engineering, forward deployed PMs, and BU leads to surface signal, resolve sequencing tradeoffs, and keep the roadmap grounded in what is actually blocking work.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 6+ years in product management with meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products at production bar.

jobs.title: Public Sector Lead, Central & Local Government
jobs.description:
About Scale

Scale builds AI systems for decisions that matter. We started out providing the data and evaluation behind many of the world's leading models, and we still work with the major frontier labs on research and post-training. Today we also build full applications: we take an organisation's own data and expertise, forward deploy alongside their teams, and build the systems they come to rely on, powered by the Scale GenAI Platform.

The Role

The UK is making a wholesale shift to AI. The government's AI Opportunities Action Plan set out to "mainline AI into the veins" of the country, and the focus has now moved to delivery: the Incubator for AI (i.AI) is shipping tools like the Humphrey suite into departments, a Sovereign AI Unit and AI Growth Zones are being stood up, and civilian departments are under real pressure to move from pilots to production. Scale can play a foundational role in building the reliable AI applications that shift depends on.

We're looking for someone to lead that work in central government. This isn’t about staying in the office and managing a team of sales people, its about building the business from the front. You'd own our commercial relationships across civilian departments, starting where the near-term pipeline is strongest: HMRC, DWP, and NHS.

This is a critical role reporting directly to our Head of Public Sector, UK. You'd carry a number, win deals yourself, and build a small team behind you as the work grows. It suits someone who has sold into these departments before and knows how they actually make decisions, not just how the org charts look.

What you'll do

  • Own our commercial plan and pipeline for UK civilian central government
  • Find, shape, and close deals yourself, from the first conversation through to contract and into delivery
  • Use the relationships you already have across departments like HMRC, DWP, and NHS
  • Work the frameworks, tenders and teaming, and know which route to market is worth the effort and which isn't.
  • Be a credible counterpart to senior civil servants, and turn what they need into work we can deliver
  • Stay close to our product and delivery teams so what we sell is what we build
  • Hire and lead a small team over time, and help shape the wider UK public sector plan with the UK Public Sector Lead

What we're looking for

  • You've sold and delivered technology or transformation work to UK civilian central government, either from a vendor or from inside government
  • You’ve rolled up your sleeves and built something from scratch, whether that’s a new vertical, territory or product launch
  • You know at least one major department well (e.g. HMRC, DWP, or NHS) and how it buys

jobs.title: Research Advisor - Human Frontier Collective (UK)
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings together top researchers and domain experts to collaborate on high-impact work that are shaping the future of AI. As an HFC Research Advisor, you’ll apply your academic and professional expertise to help develop strategy, design, evaluate, and interpret advanced generative AI systems – while gaining exposure to cutting-edge research and working alongside an interdisciplinary network of leading thinkers.

About Scale AI

Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with the world's leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI transformation through frontier AI systems that solve real business problems.

Every day, we work with organizations across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, media and telecommunications to build production AI agents that automate complex workflows, help humans, reason over enterprise knowledge, and operate safely at scale.

Applied AI is moving faster than ever. New foundation models, reasoning techniques, agent architectures, and research papers emerge every week. Yet building AI systems that reliably solve real-world problems remains one of the hardest engineering challenges.

As a Senior Frontier Agent Engineer (Applied AI), you'll bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production deployment. Our Public Sector Machine Learning team is focused on deploying cutting-edge models to mission-critical government systems through products like Donovan and Thunderforge. Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Orchestration Platform

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, RL Environments
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
About Scale AI

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact.

Scale Frontier Data is the organization behind the training and evaluation data that frontier labs depend on. We build the systems, tooling, and expert workflows that turn hard human expertise into signals that models can learn from, across reasoning, coding, agentic tool use, and domain expertise.

Reinforcement learning environments are now the center of gravity for that work: the difference between a model that demos well and a model that reliably completes long-horizon work is almost always the quality of the environments and reward signals it was trained against.

Responsibilities

As a Staff Software Engineer, RL Environments, you'll own the technical foundation for how Scale builds, runs, verifies, and delivers RL environments at scale.

An RL environment is a real piece of software: a containerized world with real dependencies, real state, real tools, and a grader that has to be correct even when the agent is creative about breaking it. Building one is a full-stack engineering problem. Building thousands of them reproducibly, cheaply, with trustworthy reward signals and throughput measured in millions of rollouts is a systems problem that very few people have solved.

You'll work on both. You'll design the platform: sandboxed execution, environment packaging and versioning, rollout orchestration, trajectory capture, verifier frameworks, and the authoring surfaces that let engineers and domain experts produce environments without reinventing infrastructure each time. And you'll go deep on the environments themselves by instrumenting real applications, designing task suites that expose specific capability gaps, and building graders that hold up under adversarial optimization.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll set technical direction across multiple teams, and you'll still be the person who writes the hard part.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals in distributed systems, system design, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Strong Python skills and a track record of shipping production software; comfort in at least one other part of the stack (TypeScript/React, Go, Rust, or similar).
  • Deep experience with containerization and sandboxed execution, including Docker, VMs, gVisor/Firecracker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.
  • Experience building or operating high-throughput backend systems: orchestration, job scheduling, queuing, and large-scale data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs including agent loops, tool calling, MCP,

Mais ce qui fait vraiment la force de 2K, ce sont nos équipes.

Dans le cadre de sa stratégie de localisation en pleine évolution, la fonction Coordination de la localisation sert de pont opérationnel entre la production de localisation intégrée, la localisation de contenu (CLOC) et l'assurance qualité linguistique (LQA).   • Piloter le soutien logistique et opérationnel offert aux parties prenantes locales et régionales de la localisation, en assurant un alignement de haut niveau entre les partenaires de production, d'assurance qualité et de développe

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

The Integrity and Attestation team's remit is to prove what is running at Anthropic: what code it is, where it came from, and whether the machine underneath it is in a known-good state. We build the systems that cryptographically verify build artifacts, model weights, and machines, from hardware roots of trust through firmware and boot to the credentials a workload receives. We also secure the management plane of our servers. These controls protect our model weights and customer data across cloud providers and bare-metal AI data centers, including sites operated by partners.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team. Anthropic is bringing up new compute quickly, across new hardware platforms and new partners, and each one has to meet the same bar. In this role you will set the team's charter, practices, and priorities. You will partner with our infrastructure, data center, and hardware teams, as well as outside vendors, so that integrity is designed in rather than added later. The goal is simple to state: a machine gets secrets and workloads only after it proves it should, and a new site reaches that bar without slowing down compute.

About the role

  • Own the integrity roadmap: threat model from silicon and firmware up through the operating system and workloads, decide what to build, and deliver it
  • Be able to reason about the design and implementation of remote attestation, measured and verified boot, hardware roots of trust (TPM, SPDM), machine identity, and the reference values that define known-good
  • Make attestation the default path, so machines receive credentials and join clusters only after proving their firmware, system software, and security configuration, with no human in the loop
  • Build provenance for what we deploy: signed build artifacts and model weights, independent verification, and tamper-evident transparency logs
  • Lead the protection of sensitive data in use and at rest, including encryption and the chokepoints that control access to it
  • Secure the server management plane across every site: scoped and audited access to baseboard management contr

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

What is the need and role

Anthropic's mission depends on compute, and compute depends on power. Today, energy is increasingly the binding constraint on how fast frontier AI infrastructure comes online. The energy team sources, structures, and contracts that power, and its work touches nearly every part of the company and a growing set of people outside it.

We're looking for someone to join the energy team in a special projects role: to take on the problems that don't sit inside any one deal or region, and to carry them wherever they lead. That means working in three circles. Inside Compute, with the teams that site, design, build, finance, and operate our data centers. Across Anthropic, with policy, legal, communications, finance, and the other teams that need energy depth or whose work shapes ours. And outside the company, with FERC, state commissions and agencies, RTOs and ISOs, utilities, industry working groups, and other large energy customers.

It's a "figure it out / get it done" role for someone who can chase down issues while bringing real depth in energy: the kind of person who can untangle a power delivery problem with design and delivery in the morning, brief the policy team on what a FERC proceeding means for our sites in the afternoon, speak for us on a working group call the next day, and then pick up an unrelated problem the energy team needs solved that week. Much of the job is building coalitions among complex, multi-functional groups of stakeholders, and then running the project all the way to completion.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's go-to-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows.

This is an engineering role that goes beyond pipelines. You'll treat GTM data as a product and a platform: built once, kept current, and available wherever people work. Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team.

Key responsibilities

  • Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first-party product and revenue data alongside third-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape

  • Build and maintain identity and entity resolution, so every source attaches to one trusted record for each company and the relationships between companies are clear

  • Help build the canonical layer where key attributes are defined once and mean the same thing everywhere, with clear sourcing logic, provenance, and freshness

  • Turn data into intelligence: scores, signals, and AI-generated attributes that help GTM teams prioritize and act, held to the same quality bar as any other source

  • Deliver that intelligence to the surfaces where teams work, including the CRM, and bring production discipline to how data moves through those systems

  • Operate what you build as a living system, with observability, data quality, cost, security, and access controls designed in, so problems surface before the field sees them

  • Partner with the owners of GTM processes such as planning, segmentation, and routing to settle definitions, make clear commitments, and communicate tradeoffs

  • Make the platform easy for other teams to build on, so work is contributed once and not rebuilt in silos

jobs.title: Senior Language Programmer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking an experienced Senior Language Programmer to join our Verse team, which owns the toolchain (compiler, VM, and runtime) that powers game development in Unreal Engine and UEFN. You'll work on the systems every UE and UEFN developer relies on to build and ship games with Verse.

In this role, you will

  • Extend, evolve, and maintain the Verse compiler toolchain, transactional memory runtime and VM, add new platform support, implement new language features and integrate with Unreal Engine's content, build, and cooking pipelines
  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and iteration times across the Verse toolchain, runtime and UE/Verse boundary
  • Work closely with language consumers to ensure an exceptional user experience
  • Establish test workflows to validate improvements and prevent regressions
  • Design and maintain the scripting interface to Unreal Engine, working in close collaboration with the Verse Language team and the broader UE engineering organization

What we're looking for

  • Expert knowledge of C++17 or later
  • Experience in compiler or toolchain development (e.g., compiler internals, VM design, Clang/LLVM, or linker/platform ABI specifics)
  • Experience developing and optimizing large codebases, with the ability to make tradeoffs between usability, performance, and power
  • Strong ability to reason about large, interconnected systems
  • Solid grounding in software engineering principles, including API design
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver practical solutions
  • Experience with Unreal Engine integration is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
